caption:
This quadratic table has one sneaky error.

From x = 3 to x = 6 is THREE jumps. Miss one and you find f(5) instead of f(6).

Comment your answer before you check.
tiktok_caption: This quadratic table answer is off by one jump. Can you find it?

youtube.title: SAT Quadratic Table: Find the Student's Error
youtube.description: Spot the off-by-one error when extending a quadratic function's table of values. SAT-style practice question (original).
